title: The Year the Bubble Burst
narrative: Elon Musk buys Twitter and burns it down. FTX collapses in fraud. Crypto winter freezes digital assets. AI image generators change art forever. Wordle proves simple games still win. Ukraine goes digital. Twitter Blue becomes a cautionary tale. The internet grew up and grew cynical.
